title: Refuse-if-token-missing guard rejects submit with 400 before any downstream handler runs
asA: shelf consumer whose Worker rejects cheap missing-token submit attempts at the earliest possible boundary
iWant: a source-tree scan to enumerate every elicited surface and confirm each carries a token-required guard, and a live missing-token submit to be refused with 400 with no downstream side-effect
soThat: no downstream handler ever executes against a missing-token submit

acceptanceCriteria.description: The Node probe guard-shape-scan enumerates every elicited surface in the pack fixture source and asserts each is registered under the token-required guard; the probe returns aggregateVerdict:pass when every elicited surface has the guard wired.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture source tree with the elicited surfaces registered
acceptanceCriteria.then: every surface is registered under the token-required guard and the probe returns aggregateVerdict:pass

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the pack fixture running on 127.0.0.1 with a real /api/submit route, when a live POST reaches /api/submit without a cf-turnstile-response field, the Turnstile guard rejects the submit with HTTP 400 whose body carries `{"errorCode":"turnstile.token-missing"}` and no downstream handler side-effect is observable.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture running with /api/submit registered under the token-required guard
acceptanceCriteria.when: a live POST reaches /api/submit without a cf-turnstile-response form field
acceptanceCriteria.then: the guard rejects with HTTP 400 and body {"errorCode":"turnstile.token-missing"} and no downstream handler side-effect is observable
